sv.title: Explosion nära Sveriges ambassad i Kiev
sv.summary: En explosion inträffade nära Sveriges ambassad i Ukrainas huvudstad Kiev på torsdagen, uppger utrikesminister Maria Malmer Stenergard (M).

en.title: Explosion near Swedish embassy in Kyiv
en.summary: An explosion occurred near the Swedish embassy in Ukraine's capital Kyiv on Thursday, according to Foreign Minister Maria Malmer Stenergard (M).
